spans.text: Today in Aktuelle Kamera, we will continue to cover the series of recent incidents.
Mrs. Gray, who has disappeared earlier, is still missing.
A large number of citizens have gathered here today to pray for her safety.
Due to the area's proximity to a nearby violent confrontation, the police is urging the citizens to leave.
The conflict is escalating rapidly. Anti-riot forces have already arrived at the scene to stabilize the situation, but the number of protesters keeps increasing as they approach the city center.
